definition: Microsoft's desktop and app virtualization service running in Azure that delivers Windows desktops and applications to users over a remote session through a client.
domain: Plan and implement an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure

definition: A collection of Azure VMs (session hosts) registered to Azure Virtual Desktop that serve desktops or RemoteApps to users.
domain: Plan and implement an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure

definition: A VM joined to a domain (AD DS or Entra Domain Services) that runs the AVD agent and hosts user sessions. It must run a supported Windows OS.
domain: Plan and implement an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure

definition: A logical grouping of application groups that appears to a user as the set of desktops and apps they can launch from the Remote Desktop client.
domain: Plan and implement an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure

definition: A control-plane object that governs access to the desktop or apps published from a host pool. The two types are Desktop and RemoteApp.
domain: Plan and implement an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure

definition: A Desktop application group publishes the full desktop (only one allowed per host pool); RemoteApp application groups publish individual applications (multiple allowed, each mapped to a Start menu item).
domain: Plan and implement an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure

definition: A service (formerly Shared Image Gallery) for storing, versioning, and sharing VM images and app packages across subscriptions and regions.
domain: Plan and implement an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure

definition: A master VM image preconfigured with the OS, applications, and settings used to deploy identical, consistently configured session hosts.
domain: Plan and implement an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure

definition: System Preparation Tool that strips machine-specific identity (SID, computer name, drivers) so an image can be captured and reused to create new VMs.
domain: Plan and implement an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure

definition: In a pooled host pool, multiple users share session hosts (non-persistent). In a personal host pool, each user is assigned a dedicated session host (persistent).
domain: Plan and implement an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure

definition: Distributes new user sessions evenly across the maximum number of session hosts, minimizing the per-host session load.
domain: Plan and implement an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure

definition: Fills one session host to its session limit before placing new sessions on the next host, minimizing the number of hosts that must be running.
domain: Plan and implement an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure

definition: A schedule that automatically powers session hosts on or off at configured times with minimum/maximum host counts and a capacity threshold, to control cost.
domain: Plan and implement an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure

definition: A time-limited token a session host presents to register itself with a host pool when the AVD agent is installed.
domain: Plan and implement an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure

definition: A session host setting that blocks new user sessions but allows existing sessions to continue, used before applying updates or decommissioning a host.
domain: Plan and implement an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure

definition: Microsoft's cloud identity provider (formerly Azure AD) used to authenticate AVD users and to control management-plane access via RBAC.
domain: Plan and implement identity and security

definition: The traditional directory service that provides domain join, Kerberos/NTLM authentication, and Group Policy for session hosts.
domain: Plan and implement identity and security

definition: A managed domain service that provides domain join, Kerberos/NTLM, LDAP, and Group Policy without you having to deploy or patch domain controllers.
domain: Plan and implement identity and security

definition: A private IP inside a virtual network that connects to a PaaS service (for example Azure Files) over Private Link, keeping that traffic off the public internet.
domain: Plan and implement identity and security

definition: A managed jump service that provides browser-based RDP/SSH to VMs without giving the VMs public IP addresses or opening management ports.
domain: Plan and implement identity and security

definition: Stores a user's complete profile (including the Office cache and search index) in a VHD/VHDX that is mounted at sign-in, enabling fast, roaming profiles.
domain: Plan and implement user environments and apps

definition: Fully managed SMB/NFS file shares; premium Azure Files (SSD-backed) is the Microsoft-recommended, cost-effective FSLogix profile storage for most deployments.
domain: Plan and implement user environments and apps

definition: A high-performance, enterprise-grade file service (SMB/NFS) used for large-scale, high-I/O FSLogix profiles and app data.
domain: Plan and implement user environments and apps

definition: Stores MSIX-packaged applications in a VHD(X) on a file share or gallery and dynamically attaches them to session hosts without reinstalling on every host.
domain: Plan and implement user environments and apps

definition: The virtual disk file FSLogix creates per user and mounts as the profile drive; the container isolates the profile from the session host OS.
domain: Plan and implement user environments and apps

definition: A set of per-host health checks (agent, connectivity, OS, domain trust) reported as Available, Unavailable, or Shutdown, plus a numeric health value.
domain: Monitor and maintain an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure

definition: A workbook built on Azure Monitor and Log Analytics that visualizes usage, performance, connection reliability, and user activity for AVD.
domain: Monitor and maintain an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure

definition: Collects metrics and diagnostics from host pools, workspaces, and session hosts so you can alert on and troubleshoot performance and connection issues.
domain: Monitor and maintain an Azure Virtual Desktop infrastructure
